- Quote from CTO: 'If we can get consistent top-3 precision and avoid false positives on clauses, we can replace manual review.'
- AE notes / recommended play: position Hosted API self-serve for fast POC; provide Python quickstart, sample rerank prompt templates, and a minimal eval harness (5k contract slices). SE to run technical POC to validate p95 latency and top-3 precision.
